item.text: The helper owns both token creation and the verification modal today. I found five direct callers and an existing test file for the polling process. I’ll preserve the modal behavior while moving it into a reusable verifier.

One behavior needs care: tokenization can return chargeable, pending, or a failure status. I’m making those paths explicit so pending tokens alone enter the injectable verifier. I’ll also make polling use timers that can be advanced deterministically in tests.
